title: Multiphase ElastogrAPHy of the Aorta in Health ans DiseASE
summary: In this research project the elasticity (stiffness) of the Aorta will be examined in more detail. The aim is to use a new imaging technique (ultrasound or MR elastography) to examine how the tissue stiffness of the aortic wall changes individually over a period of time of five years.

interventions.name:
Multiphase elastography is performed as an (additional) examination in ultrasound or MRI after recording standardised diagnostic markers.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written consent prior to study-specific activities.
2. The individual is capable of giving consent and able to understand the nature and implications of the study. 
3. Age over 18 years.
4. Confirmed hypertension/aortic dilatation based on current clinical recommendations or imaging without the pre-existing conditions listed under the exclusion criteria (patient group) or
5. Exclusion of arterial hypertension or aortic ectasia (control group)
Exclusion criteria:
1. persons under the age of 18
2. in the case of MRI: implants that are not approved for MRI
3. unclear medical history, reduced insight.
4. seriously ill patients
5. pregnancy
